snapshot.sql: SELECT player_id, original_email, proposed_email, state FROM admin_player_email_edits ORDER BY player_id, proposed_email, state

snapshot.name: admin_audit_events
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, actor_admin_id, action, target_type, target_id, source_command_id, occurred_at, metadata - 'requestId' AS metadata, (metadata ? 'requestId') AS has_request, COALESCE(metadata->>'requestId' IN (SELECT id::text FROM player_contact_change_requests), false) AS request_known FROM admin_audit_events ORDER BY action, target_id, source_command_id NULLS FIRST, metadata::text, occurred_at

snapshot.name: player_notifications
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, player_id, kind, title, body, target, source_type, COALESCE(source_id IN (SELECT id FROM player_contact_change_requests), false) AS source_is_request, read_at FROM player_notifications ORDER BY player_id, kind, source_type, title, body
